terms.description: The terms of use, in markdown.

entity.description: The name of the legal entity that operates the provider.

abuseContact.description: An email address or a URL to report abuse to.

jurisdiction.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country where the provider operates, in uppercase.

main.description: The acceptable-use terms of a provider. The terms are in the record, so the CID of the record that a client accepts identifies the terms. To change the terms, the provider writes a new record. The terms are not in link.jetbridge.provider, so a change of address does not change what clients accepted.
